raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Overall Work Experience: 11 Years
CURRENT ROLE: Senior Associate – Barclays Global Service Centre Private Limited.
CORPORATE TITLE: Markets Business Control Manager
TENURE: FEBRAURY 2024 – MAY 2026 (2 years 4 months)
TEAM: Chief Controls Office – Markets Governance.
Areas of Expertise include:

Indirect Retail Product Governance - Controls management – RCSA – Controls Testing.
Control and Governance Forums – Risk event/Issues management – MI reports – FCA and
ESMA Markets Benchmark Index assessment.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Control checks on Front office trade bookings to ensure Primary fee, Secondary fee, Distributor fee charged are within threshold as per Fee Framework.
Pre and Post trade quantitative analysis by stress testing/reverse enquiry to check the
Downside Risk reduction, Potential for higher return. Exceptions are flagged in SET tool to Sales team to approve rationale.
Work as control business partner with Sales and third-party service provider to monitor
Distributor onboarding, Due diligence questionnaire refresh, adverse news alerts and Distributor feedback across regions adhere to the Control Framework.
Assist with the assessment of risks & controls for Indirect Retail business across Markets
through the RCSA (Risk and Control Assessment).
Maintain appropriate controls in RCSA and Sentinel platform. - Year- round independent testing of key business controls to provide assurance to business

that processes are designed and operating effectively. Identifying the deficiency in the existing process by raising Gap & Action plans and tracking them till those are remediated.
Adhering to all elements of the Risk and Control Framework including risk identification,
assessment, mitigation, trigger events, monitoring, etc.
Manage Governance submissions which includes preparation of agenda, materials, minutes, tracking action points arising out of the Forums. Update and refresh Terms of Reference.
Policy and Procedure Management for Indirect Retail business across Markets in Barclays
Data Portal. Engage in Annual EUDA (End User Developed Application) refresh.
Responsibility to check and authorise the new Benchmark Index which Sales look for trading
are ESMA/FCA registered and exceptions applicable.
Generate MI reports for management review and decision for Chair in Control Forums.
PREVIOUS ROLE: Senior Analyst - BNY Mellon (I) International Operations.
TENURE: FEBRAURY 2017 – DECEMBER 2023 (6 years 10 months)
TEAMS: Custody and Middle Office - Cash and Securities settlements & Reconciliation.
Areas of Expertise include:
Derivatives ETD and OTC market - Collateral management - SWIFT payments.
Mutual funds at Transfer agency - Cash and securities settlements (CASS) – Reconciliation.
SSI mandates for static referential data – Brokerage.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Pre and post settlement of trades, Mutual fund (cash & securities), ETD/OTC derivatives and
Collateral at Custody and Middle office. Payment SWIFT (MT202, MT210).

Independent validation of work performed by the maker. Verify and authorize payments
before the currency cut-off time. Cash transfer, return of funds, branch sweep activities as per
follow of CASS rules.
Cash & Stock break Reconciliation TLM, resolve exceptions and post adjustments.
Chase, escalate with brokers, transfer agents and custodian via emails/ phone calls for cash
fails. Processing within the SLA’s as required by the Client.
Review of legal documentation completeness unit’s registration, stock transfer forms, AML
doc, cheque stop payment and SSI banking mandates for static referential data DTCC Alert.
To manage the sensitive client calls, report disputes, fail trades and cash breaks.
Report all risk incidents to functional line manager and tracked till resolution.
Prepare management MI report for the team on a weekly/monthly basis. Update KPI/KRI.
Regular review of Procedures. Identification and improving current core procedures.
To perform route cause analysis of errors and suggest/ implement controls in consultation
with the Supervisor/ Manager.

Lead & manage all new migrations aligned to the functions.
Preparing work allocation for team. Deliver training/coaching to the new joiners, conduct cross
regional trainings. Ensure 4 eye control check are in place, monitor daily checklist signoff.
PREVIOUS ROLE: Front Office Executive - Microsoft (I) Pvt. Ltd.
TENURE: AUGEST 2012 - MARCH 2014 (1.6 years)
